rules.description: Ensures active CRDC Algebra 1 StatVars have data up to at least 2024.

params.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_svs, MIN(MaxDate) AS min_max_date FROM stats WHERE NOT regexp_matches(StatVar, '_SchoolGrade[78]_|^Count_Student_(Pass_(Female|Male)_SchoolGrade(7To8|9To10|11To12)|EnrolledInEducationOrTraining_(Female|Male)_SchoolGrade7To8)_Algebra1$')

rules.description: Checks that deleted records do not exceed 0.1%.
Checks that missing references count does not exceed the threshold.
Checks that lint error count is 0.
